crosswalk_method: Active MOIS KIKcd_B and KIKcd_H joined by KIKmix, effective 2026-09-30, freshly downloaded 2026-10-10. The current Gyeonggi Gwangju-si municipal administrative-area table, last updated 2026-09-21, corroborates the exact 26 legal dong/eup/myeon names, 16 administrative units and all 27 relations. City aggregate and 62 active MOIS legal ri excluded. The municipal summary omits Namjong-myeon Ucheon-ri among the lower-level ri; this does not change the 26-unit canonical denominator or the 27 relations. Taejeon-dong spans Gwangnam 1-dong and Gwangnam 2-dong; both relations are partial. The municipal table identifies the north/south sides of Mokricheon, but no parcel boundaries are inferred. Former Opo-eup and its seven former legal ri are not current canonical units; seven current legal dongs created 2022-09-01 are included. This is Gyeonggi Gwangju-si (41610), not Gwangju Metropolitan City. Future-effective 2026-10-12 dataset excluded.
